# v0.1.0 — User Video Review and QA Checklist
**Status:** First-run acceptance guide; not yet tested. **One complete review video after Claude's broad first build.**

## Before recording
- Launch the *actual v0.1.0 dev app* in CachyOS using Claude's verified Bash command. Keep PokeMMO in normal/windowed or borderless mode on primary and Companion on second monitor; do not alter game files.
- Use a clean test **character run** and test dataset without exposing personal data, passwords or ROM filenames.
- If testing notifications, click a **Demo/Test notification** clearly labelled DEMO; do not assert it came from live PokeMMO.
- Make sure Claude specifies **keep Companion open / close Companion** before build and relaunch commands.

## Record in this order
1. **App shell:** startup time, Home content, logo, Better Default feel; horizontal -> vertical navigation without page reset; window resizing.
2. **Home:** open latest official news article *inside app*; open an event with its actual details; inspect date/source, stale/offline labels and in-app back navigation.
3. **Pokédex:** scroll species grid, search different species, filter regions/types, open details and location/move tabs, open a detail popout, test missing artwork fallback.
4. **Tools:** grouped page; type chart, nature, breeding two-parent preview, saved plan/tree, an enabled calculator and its accuracy disclaimer.
5. **Live:** Alpha/Swarm report history, source health; one custom TEST toast and OS notification; roaming roadmap; cave data marked unknown if not verified.
6. **Guides:** create two named character runs with no portraits; select a region, check a few objectives, switch to another run and verify independent progress; open the translucent Standard guide popout.
7. **Popouts:** pin/unpin, opacity, resize/mode Compact/Standard/Expanded, minimize main app, focus game and click outside popout; always-on-top where supported.
8. **Settings:** per-tool appearance vs global, text scale, nav orientation, notifications, tray behavior, accessible keyboard controls.
9. **Restart:** close completely as documented, relaunch, confirm named runs, checkboxes, filters, window preferences, selected page persisted.

## What to note while filming
- Page that feels cramped, too many buttons, inconsistent font/colour/type tag, unreadable translucency, empty/placeholder cards.
- Anything clickable that does nothing or gives a false success.
- Window flicker, focus-stealing, panel drifting off-screen, scaling failures, Wayland limitations.
- Broken or inaccurate PokeMMO information, outdated event status, 'live' false claims, formula inconsistency.
- Any popup that forces the game off-screen or blocks clicks outside its bounds.
- Unexpected edits to original game/theme/ROM files or system settings: **stop test and report.**

## After recording
Provide video and any screenshots/logs; triage into **critical blockers**, **polish**, **new suggestions**. Keep `develop` as work branch; do not change `main` until reviewed.
We then decide whether v0.1.0 needs a corrective build or if version advances to **0.1.1**. Versioning starts progressing *after review*, not automatically after each internal commit.

## Acceptance thresholds for first demo
- One normal app with five actual pages, not five standalone fake demos.
- Independent popout(s) functioning on tested platform or clearly documented OS fallback.
- No silent data loss after restart.
- No false precise live information, exact odds or fabricated gameplay calculations.
- At least one useful, honest working path through each primary page.
- No extra permanent branches or PokeMMO copyrighted assets in public repo.
